Resolves #21022

Related: #20892, #20894, #20805, Discussion #21005

Extends `buildScripts/util/claimResponse.mjs` and `.github/workflows/claim-responder.yml` so outside pull requests targeting curated issues (`good first issue`, `help wanted`) participate in the claim path without fabricating issue comments: openings and newly added body close targets request assignment on unclaimed issues under standing and 3-day expiry rules (attaching authors GitHub permits — issue commenters or the issue author — while warning without failure on unattachable authors) or post one neutral `neo-claim:v1` overlap / residual-scope notice on held or already-merged targets, target removals release only verified workflow-created PR assignments, and unmerged closes keep release notices disabled by default (`CLAIM_RELEASE_SINCE = null`, overridable via repository variable `NEO_CLAIM_RELEASE_SINCE`) until the program's owner (`@neo-fable-mnemosyne`, or `@tobiu` if no agent seat can write repository variables) sets the dated cut after observing the first real opening, then emit one deduplicated release notice on open curated issues when no live holder remains (catching errors with a warning on `closed` events so closed heads never carry failed checks).

Evidence: L2 (Playwright unit and `github-script` workflow suite over `claimResponse.mjs` and `claim-responder.yml`; GitHub `pull_request_target` runs only from the default branch after merge) → L3 required (AC-12 post-merge observation of the first real pull request opening and first real unmerged close after activation). Residual: AC-12, Residual-Owner: #20892.

## Deltas from ticket
- **Source-versus-activation boundary (`#20892`, separate from `neomjs/neo-agent-skills#401`):** In `buildScripts/util/claimResponse.mjs`, `CLAIM_RELEASE_SINCE` defaults to `null`, and `.github/workflows/claim-responder.yml` resolves `process.env.NEO_CLAIM_RELEASE_SINCE?.trim() || CLAIM_RELEASE_SINCE` (from `vars.NEO_CLAIM_RELEASE_SINCE`), returning early without posting while `null` and enforcing that boundary on both `decidePullRequestRelease` checks once set. Source merge alone therefore enables zero unmerged-close release notices. Actual E3 readiness and recording the dated `NEO_CLAIM_RELEASE_SINCE` Actions variable belong to the program's owner (`@neo-fable-mnemosyne`, or `@tobiu` if no agent seat can write repository variables) after `@neo-gemini-maryam` observes and links the first real pull request opening under `#20892`; `neomjs/neo-agent-skills#401` is the separate assistance-policy stream and does not own E3 activation.
- **Close-target parser hardening:** Replaced multi-character Markdown stripping regexes and nested quantifier separators in `closeTargets` (`buildScripts/util/claimResponse.mjs`) with a linear-time `stripIgnoredMarkdown` scanner and non-overlapping punctuation matching, and normalized `changes.body.from === null` to `''` in `changedCloseTargets` so PR edits adding close targets to an empty initial body are detected.
- **Round-1 review alignment (`794969a1c3`):** Differentiated completed-issue residual-scope notices (`hasCompletedNotice` matching `'residual-scope review'` + `heldBy: pr:<merged>`) from earlier opening overlap notices, wrapped `closed` (merged and unmerged) and `pull_request_target` `addAssignees` paths in `try/catch` warning guards, and aligned `claimResponse.spec.mjs` `createHarness.addAssignees` with GitHub's issue-commenter/author attachment rule.
- Pre-existing `isClaim` gap on `"Please assign it"` in `buildScripts/util/claimResponse.mjs`: out of scope, noted in `defect-note` `MESSAGE:631de6d9-7f22-4646-92d5-4dff007851a1` (`#20676`).

To proceed with merging, please address the following:

- [ ] **RA-1 · The harness refuses what GitHub refuses, and the text says who is assigned.** In the pull-request arm's fake, `addAssignees` attaches a login only when that account has a comment on the issue or wrote it; one arm runs an opening by an author with neither and asserts no assignee, no notice, the warning and no failed run; the workflow's header, the JSDoc of `decidePullRequestTarget` and the body's AC-1 row say that the assignment reaches only an author GitHub can attach.
  - `GET /repos/neomjs/neo/issues/{issue}/assignees/{login}` at 18:14Z and 18:20Z answers 404 for five authors of open pull requests who never commented on their issue (pull requests `21042, 21009, 20951, 21007, 20824`), 204 for a commenter on the same issue and for a team member, 404 for an account with no trace on it.
  - The head's own `closeTargets` over the 89 outside pull requests created since Oct 16 (read at 18:19Z, labels as they are now): 87 target a curated issue, and in 30 of them the author had neither commented on the issue before the opening nor written it.
  - The fake (`target.assignees = [...]` in `createHarness`) attaches every login; arm 1's `outside-dev` has no comment on its issue.
- [ ] **RA-2 · A pull request that carries an overlap notice still gets the completed-issue notice when its holder merges.** The completed-issue notice is deduplicated on the merged pull request it names (`heldBy: pr:<merged>`), not on any overlap record for the issue; one arm: an overlap notice at the opening, then the holder merges, gives exactly one completed-issue notice, and a second delivery of that merge gives none.
  - Module at `b6a62298`: once the second pull request's comments hold `{"kind":"overlap","issue":100,"pr":202,"heldBy":"pr:201"}` and the first one merges, `decidePullRequestTarget` returns `null`; the control without that record returns the notice. `hasOverlap()` matches on issue and pull request only.
  - This is the commonest order: the later pull request is told at its opening, and the earlier one merges.
- [ ] **RA-3 · No run on a `closed` event ends failed.** Both `closed` paths (the completed-issue notices after a merge, the release notice after an unmerged close) catch what throws, warn, write nothing further and end green; one arm per path with a read that throws.
  - A `pull_request_target` run anchors its check on the event's head, and after a close nobody can turn it green (#20061). The merged path runs for every merged pull request with a close target, the team's included, with four reads per target.
- [ ] **RA-4 · The body names who records the activation date.** "Deltas from ticket" and AC-12 under "Post-Merge Validation" say that the program's owner records `NEO_CLAIM_RELEASE_SINCE` after the first real opening is observed, as the restated #21022 AC-12 has it.
